feeds.title: Not Entirely Average
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jenny. A Yankee's bid at southern eats is my personal journey mastering deep-rooted Southern cuisine despite a steadfast Yankee upbringing. I am a Charleston, South Carolina-based culinary novice, an ardent authority on all things travel, designer by trade, and creator of Not Entirely Average.

feeds.title: Spicy Southern Kitchen
feeds.description: Find excellent food and drink recipes straight from the South! Also covers unique recipes for everything from appetizers to desserts and even cocktails!

feeds.title: Julias Simply Southern
feeds.description: Hey, Y'all! I am Julia. I grew up in South Carolina and love to share my tasty southern cooking blog posts, easy-to-follow recipes, and experiences with everyone.

feeds.title: The April Blake
feeds.description: The April Blake is a South Carolina based food blog with recipes for classic Southern dishes, inventive modern desserts, and healthy dinners.

feeds.title: Callie's Hot Little Biscuit Blog
feeds.description: Callie's Hot Little Biscuit Blog is a food blog that focuses on Southern comfort food, with a particular emphasis on the classic Southern biscuit. Founded by Carrie Morey, the blog features recipes for both sweet and savory biscuits, as well as tips on cooking and entertaining. The blog also features stories and profiles on local food producers and chefs.

feeds.title: Off The Grid Greenville » Eat & Drink
feeds.description: A Guide to the Best Greenville Restaurants, Events, and Lifestyle. Off the Grid Greenville is a non-profit 5013C organization that is dedicated to helping small businesses in the Upstate of South Carolina achieve brand awareness through marketing assistance and educational programs.

feeds.title: Tasty As Fit
feeds.description: Hi! I am Emilie Blanchard. I couldn't be more excited to share a little bit about myself and my love of fresh, 'real' food with you. Here you will find all the recipes for the plant-based meals featured on my Instagram as well as this week's grab-n-go & smoothie menu for all our local Columbia, SC & Greenville, SC residents. Though the recipes you discover throughout this site are plant-based, we like to win over ALL eaters.

feeds.title: Southern Food Junkie
feeds.description: Southern Food Junkie brings you the best restaurants, food, and recipes from the South! It is all about the road trip to find the best and unique eateries in the South. They also share some of their favorite recipes or southern dishes along with doing reviews of unique foods and drinks.

feeds.title: Queen of the Food Age
feeds.description: I'm Sydney Gallimore. Queen of the Food Age is a blog about everything food related, featuring quotes, recipes, reviews, events, pictures, musings and other random fodder that pops into my brain.

feeds.title: Zero Restaurant + Bar Blog
feeds.description: A guide to Charleston for the discerning traveler and foodie. Explore some of the top things to do in Charleston, and get the latest news from Zero Restaurant + Bar. Zero Restaurant + Bar features contemporary American cuisine focusing on sustainable and local ingredients.
